title: TimeBand
description: Time, day, season and holiday applicability for ToD/seasonal charges. See docs/data/INDIA_CI_TARIFF_DATA_STRATEGY.md section 5.5.

label.description: Regulator's original label for this band, e.g. 'Peak', 'Off-Peak', 'Night'.

time_zone.description: All Indian tariffs use IST; kept explicit rather than assumed by calculation code.

end_time.description: Local end time, HH:MM, 24-hour. May be less than start_time to indicate a span crossing midnight.

applicable_days.description: Days this band applies to. Include HOLIDAY only where the source explicitly defines holiday treatment.

season_start_date.description: Recurring annual season start as --MM-DD, if this band is seasonal.

season_end_date.description: Recurring annual season end as --MM-DD, if this band is seasonal.
